svg.title: ADAPT-QAOA MaxCut
svg.text: ADAPT-QAOA solves MaxCut on a triangle
The algorithm grows a quantum circuit one layer at a time until all the chance sits on the best ways to cut the triangle.
Layer 1: pick the mixer that lowers ⟨H⟩ fastest
Layer 1: cost step e^(-iγH) on all 3 edges, γ = 0.39
Layer 1: mixer X on qubit 1, β = -0.79
Done: every mixer's slope is below 0.001
The triangle: one qubit per node
fill = chance the qubit reads 1 (blue 0%, orange 100%)
Each qubit is 0 and 1 at once,
X on qubits 0, 1, 2 tie at slope 0.78;
The cost step turns each answer's arrow
X on qubit 1, β = -0.79: the arrows
so all 8 splits are equally likely
by γ × its energy; the bars do not move
add up or cancel, and the bars move
Mixer pool: how fast each lowers ⟨H⟩
bits = q0 q1 q2; green = a best cut (2 of 3 edges)
Arrows: each answer's amplitude. The cost step only turns them;
the mixer makes them add up or cancel, and that moves the bars.
Energy ⟨H⟩ after each step (lower is better)
